_how_to: Each entry below becomes a page at https://lens-laboratory.com/group-lit-feed/plain-b-<slug>.html after the next daily run.
slug: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only. This is the link, so keep it once shared.
slices: any slice codes' slugs from plain.html (e.g. wbg-voc, icl). The bundle starts from these papers.
any: plain phrases; a paper must mention at least one (title or its own contribution). Spaces/hyphens and plurals are forgiving.
all: plain phrases; a paper must mention every one.
exclude: plain phrases; papers with these in the TITLE are dropped.
class: PV (default), LED, DET, or any.
Leave out slices to search the whole halide-perovskite archive by phrases only.
If this file has a mistake, the daily run still works: plain.html shows the problem at the top and uses built-in defaults.
